# Review rubric

Save as docs/runbooks/review-rubric.md. Score every page and every piece of
copy before it goes anywhere. Nothing ships below "pass" on every row.

Page / copy: ______________________   Date: __________   Reviewer: __________

| Dimension | Pass means | Standard | Pass / fail | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Brief fit | Goal, audience and call to action are met; nothing was invented to fill a gap | The brief | | |
| Brand consistency | Only DESIGN.md tokens; typefaces and colours on-system; no generic tells (default fonts, gradient washes, identical cards, all-caps labels, arrows on links) | DESIGN.md, art-direction block | | |
| Usability | No violation of Nielsen's ten heuristics rated major or above | NN/g | | |
| Accessibility | AA contrast; semantic HTML; alt text; visible focus; keyboard order; 44px targets | WCAG 2.2 AA | | |
| Content | Voice and tone per state; agreed terminology; within length limits; buttons say the action | brand-voice skill, microcopy matrix | | |
| Truthfulness | No invented facts, testimonials, statistics or sources; every claim traceable | Editorial policy | | |
| Evidence | Screenshots at 390px and 1440px and check output were supplied, not claimed | Verification habit | | |
| Greek (if present) | Glossary followed; native reviewer has signed off | glossary-el.md | | |

Overall: pass / fail. What one instruction would have prevented the worst
failure? Add it to CLAUDE.md or the relevant skill now:
